newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Transaero begins Moscow-NY route in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Russian Transaero begins Moscow-NY route in Aug.

text.p: Private Russian aircarrier Transaero, expanding its service to the United States, will begin regular passenger flights between Moscow and New York in August, a company spokeswoman said on Thursday.
Natalia Alexashina said the weekly flight would on a DC-10-30 jet.
Transaero has been making scheduled flights on the Moscow-Los Angeles route since June 1996 and plans to expand its U.S. routes.

The company might also start regular flights from Moscow to Hong Kong on a Boeing 767 at the end of this month. "We are resolving the last technical problems in order to begin these flights," Alexashina said.
The airline flies from Moscow to 29 cities in Russia, the Commonwealth of Independent States, Europe and the United States.
